Software Development

Become a World Class Software Developer

Software developers are the builders of the digital world. This program equips you with the skills to create web and mobile applications from scratch, covering both frontend and backend. With salaries ranging from $6,000 to $35,000 annually, software development is one of the most versatile and rewarding tech careers.

 

Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Beginner Friendly

No prior experience required.

Job Placement Support

Launch your career with internships and job placements.

Flexible Learning

Choose to learn at a pace that fits your schedule.

World-Class Tutors & Mentorship

Learn directly from industry experts.

Certificate

Earn a recognised certificate.

Download Course Brochure & Curriculum

Course Overview

The Software Development course is designed to help students build a strong foundation in programming, software architecture, and application development.
Through hands-on learning and real-world projects, you’ll gain the skills to design, build, and deploy robust software solutions for web, mobile, and enterprise environments.

This course is ideal for anyone looking to start a career in software engineering or transition into technical roles that require strong programming and problem-solving skills.

Learning Outcome

  1. Understand the principles of software design, architecture, and development lifecycles.
  2. Write clean, efficient code using modern programming languages like Python, JavaScript, or Java.
  3. Develop full-featured applications integrating front-end and back-end technologies.
  4. Apply version control, testing, and deployment best practices to build scalable, maintainable systems.

Next Cohort Starts
October 31st 2026

Duration: 6 months
Enrol Now
Apply For Scholarship

Career Opportunities

  1. United States – $90,000 – $140,000 USD
  2. United Kingdom – £55,000 – £90,000 GBP
  3. Canada – $75,000 – $115,000 CAD
  4. Germany – €60,000 – €95,000 EUR
  5. Nigeria – ₦6 million – ₦10.5 million NGN
  6. Kenya – KSh 3 million – KSh 5.2 million KES
  7. Remote/Global Roles – $75,000 – $125,000 USD

Career Pathways

  1. Software Engineer / Developer
  2. Full-Stack Developer
  3. Mobile Application Developer
  4. DevOps Engineer
  5. Technical Product Manager (entry route)

What You Will Learn

Go from Idea to Impact, become a Software Developer in 3-6 Months.

Module 1 - Introduction to Full Stack Development
  • Overview of Frontend, Backend, and Databases
  • Roles and Responsibilities of a Full Stack Developer
  • Tools, Technologies, and Development Environments
Module 2 - Web Fundamentals
  • How the Web Works: Client–Server Model
  • HTTP, Browsers, and APIs
  • Introduction to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
Module 3 - HTML Deep Dive
  • Building Web Page Structures
  • Semantic HTML and Accessibility
  • Forms, Tables, and Multimedia
Module 4 - CSS and Responsive Design
  • CSS Fundamentals: Selectors, Box Model, and Flexbox
  • Grid Layouts and Media Queries
  • CSS Animations and Transitions
Module 5 - JavaScript Programming
  • Variables, Data Types, Loops, and Functions
  • DOM Manipulation and Event Handling
  • ES6+ Features and Modular JS
Module 6 - Frontend Frameworks (React.js)
  • Introduction to React
  • Components, Props, and State
  • React Hooks and Routing (React Router)
  • Working with APIs in React
Module 7 - Version Control and Collaboration
  • Git Basics and Branching
  • Working with GitHub and Pull Requests
  • Collaborative Development Workflows
Module 8 - Backend Development with Node.js and Express
  • Node.js Fundamentals and NPM
  • Creating RESTful APIs with Express.js
  • Routing, Middleware, and Controllers
Module 9 - Databases and Data Modeling
  • SQL vs NoSQL Databases
  • Designing Database Schemas
  • Using MongoDB or PostgreSQL
  • CRUD Operations and Relationships
Module 10 - Authentication and Authorization
  • User Registration and Login Systems
  • JWT Authentication and Cookies
  • Role-Based Access Control
Module 11 - API Development and Integration
  • Building and Testing APIs with Postman
  • Connecting Frontend to Backend
  • Error Handling and Data Validation
Module 12 - Deployment & DevOps
  • Hosting Frontend and Backend Apps (Render, Vercel, Netlify)
  • Introduction to CI/CD Pipelines
  • Environment Variables and Production Builds
Module 13 - Testing and Debugging
  • Unit and Integration Testing (Jest, Mocha)
  • Debugging Techniques and Tools
  • Code Quality and Linting
Module 14 - Advanced Topics
  • TypeScript Basics
  • Performance Optimization
  • Introduction to Docker and Cloud Deployment
Module 15 - Capstone Project
  • Plan, Build, and Deploy a Full Stack Application
  • Include User Authentication, Database, and API Integration
  • Host and Present Final Project
  • Plan, Build, and Deploy a Full Stack Application
  • Include User Authentication, Database, and API Integration

Frequently Asked Questions

I don’t have a tech background.
70% of our graduates started with zero tech experiences. Our beginner-friendly approach starts with basics and builds progressively
I can’t afford it
Up to 50-100% scholarship coverage available. You only pay registration and certification fees upfront.
I don't have time
Flexible learning schedules including evenings and weekends. Complete the program while maintaining your current job.
Will I actually get a job?
Guaranteed internship placement + access to exclusive job board with 500+ partner companies actively hiring our graduates
